w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Big Big, The Eulogy, Inspiration, The Redactor) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Spool stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Chorus Line. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
Aroha has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)
📓 Codex: Aroha picked up Lucky Rock from talking with you — what it does, and what it might go with.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The watch holds the wall. You sleep through the worst of it — or would have, if the shouting had let you.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/9/6), with 8 wave-4 fought, 15 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 9 · Craft 10 · Talk 25 → 24 · capped · Explore 32 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Aroha Ngata ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
